title: Variant structure predictions for the DELPHI flight/gliding panel
label: STRUCTURE PREDICTION, NOT FUNCTION. No transport, conductance or binding assay exists for any variant here; the only functional data in our chains are the zebrafish fin phenotypes, which are organism-level, not molecular.
bird_exclusion: Class Aves is this project's frozen holdout; no bird sequence was folded.

method.wild_type_model: AlphaFold DB model for the zebrafish UniProt accession in structures/models.json; per-residue pLDDT read from the CA B-factor column of the deposited mmCIF.
method.variant_prediction: Meta's public ESMFold endpoint https://api.esmatlas.com/foldSequence/v1/pdb/ (POST, raw sequence, no key). Wild type and variant are folded as the SAME window of the SAME sequence so the comparison is like-for-like; the window is the full chain when ESMFold accepts it and a centred window otherwise, which is recorded per variant.
method.rmsd: CA-atom RMSD after optimal Kabsch superposition over every residue of the folded window (wild type and variant have identical length, so the alignment is the identity).
method.position_check: Every position is checked against the fetched UniProt sequence; a mismatch is reported, not silently corrected, because the source's numbering may be another species' or another isoform's.

skipped.variant: kcnh2a revertant alleles lof^lfr1 Y669N, lof^lfr2 L739Q, lof^WL7 Y418X
skipped.why: positions ARE given, but they are revertants recovered in cis to a regulatory allele whose phenotype is loss of the ectopic expression, not a change in channel structure; folded here would answer a question nobody asked. Recorded, not modelled.

skipped.variant: prdm1a m805 (p.W154*) and hhip hu418B Y295STOP / hu540A Y285STOP
skipped.why: premature stops, i.e. truncations. A predicted structure of a truncated chain says nothing about the full-length protein's function; and no fetched source measures the truncated protein. Positions recorded, no model.
frameshifts: the downstream sequence is not given by any fetched source, so the variant protein sequence is unknown and cannot be folded.

esmfold_service.what_happened: The endpoint served the first two folds (a 350-residue window of zebrafish Kcnk5b, wild type and W169L) and then returned HTTP 504 "Endpoint request timed out" to every later request, including a deliberate 66-residue probe. So this is a service outage during the run, not a sequence-length limit: one wild-type/variant pair was obtained and the rest were not.
esmfold_service.consequence: For the variants without an ESMFold pair, what is reported instead is (a) the per-residue pLDDT of the wild-type AlphaFold DB model around the site and (b) the position measured in a deposited experimental structure (distance to the partner subunit, to a bound ligand, to a bound ion), which is stronger evidence than a prediction anyway. The missing runs are reproducible: rerun structures/scripts/build_variants.py when the endpoint is up; the cache makes everything else free.
